reference: The manager, whose clipboard never leaves her hand, knows every task.
sk: Manažérka, ktorej zoznam nikdy neopustí ruku, pozná každú úlohu.
cz: Manažerka, jejíž seznam nikdy neopustí ruku, zná každý úkol.
acceptable: The manager, whose {clipboard|list} never leaves her hand, knows {every|each} task.

mistakes.text: The manager, which {clipboard|list} never leaves her hand, knows every task.
The manager, who {clipboard|list} never leaves her hand, knows every task.
mistakes.feedback_en: The clipboard belongs to her, so use “whose”, not “who”.

mistakes.text: The manager, whose her {clipboard|list} never leaves her hand, knows every task.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Whose“ už znamená „jej“, „her“ za ním je navyše.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Whose“ už znamená „její“, „her“ za ním je navíc.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Whose” already means “her”, so drop the extra “her”.

mistakes.text: The manager, whose {clipboard|list} never leave her hand, knows every task.
mistakes.feedback_en: With a singular subject like “clipboard” the Present Simple form is “leaves”.

mistakes.text: The manager, whose {clipboard|list} never leaves the hand, knows every task.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri častiach tela patrí v angličtine „her“, nie „the“: „her hand“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U částí těla patří v angličtině „her“, ne „the“: „her hand“.
mistakes.feedback_en: English uses a possessive with body parts: “her hand”.

source_issues: Slovak 'zoznam' and Czech 'seznam' mean 'list', the English says 'clipboard'; both accepted.
